description: Smartphones are available with 4GB, 6GB, 8GB, 12GB and 16GB of RAM. 4GB is generally limited to entry-level phones, while 6GB can handle everyday use. 8GB and 12GB of RAM are mostly found in mid-range handsets. There are also smartphones with 24GB of RAM. Gaming-focused phones such as the RedMagic 10 Pro and OnePlus 13 are available with 24GB of RAM.
title: How Much RAM Do You Really Need in a Smartphone?

description: Gaming laptop buyers have several options below Rs. 1 lakh, with the models in this list offering Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050 graphics and at least 16GB RAM. title: Best Gaming Laptops Under Rs 1 Lakh in India From Asus, Acer, HP and More

description: Google lets Android phone users check the battery health of their handsets directly in the Settings menu. Hence, users do not have to download third-party apps to check the same. However, it is worth noting that your Android phone will only display an estimated percentage of battery health, while comparing the same with its capacity when it was brand new and unused. There are multiple benefits of checking your Android phone’s battery health. It helps you know how much your Android phone’s battery has depleted, compared to when you bought your handset.
title: How to Check Battery Health on an Android Phone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: A tablet can be a powerful companion for students. So, if you’re in the market for a new tablet, there are plenty of compelling options to choose from.
title: Best Tablets for Students in India: OnePlus Pad Go 2, Xiaomi Pad 8, Redmi Pad 2 Pro, and More
